title: Rubber-duck review verdict
description: The reviewer's final message. run-review.mts hands this schema to codex (--output-schema) and claude (--json-schema) so the final answer cannot be free text; copilot has no schema flag and must emit this object itself.

blocking.description: Findings that must be fixed before the change lands.

non_blocking.description: Findings worth fixing that do not block on their own.

recorded_not_built.description: Speculative hardening, one line each. Not findings; the driving agent decides whether any is built.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what was reviewed and how it was checked. With no findings, state plainly that the code is correct.

where.description: File and line, or the symbol.

claim.description: What is wrong, in one sentence.

evidence.description: The concrete input or state and the wrong output, crash, or data loss it produces, or the concrete maintainability cost in this change.
